zh.action.createImage.label: Nano Banana 文生图
zh.action.createImage.description: 使用 Google Gemini Nano Banana 从文字描述生成图片，支持 Grounding 与 Thinking
zh.action.editImage.label: Nano Banana 图片编辑
zh.action.editImage.description: 基于参考图、多轮历史或视频进行 AI 图片编辑与融合，最多 14 张参考图
zh.action.models.label: Nano Banana 模型列表
zh.action.models.description: 列出可用的 Gemini 模型
zh.field.apiKey.label: API Key
zh.field.prompt.label: 图片描述
zh.field.prompt.tooltip: 描述你想生成的场景，叙事性描述优于关键词堆砌
zh.field.promptEdit.label: 编辑描述
zh.field.promptEdit.tooltip: 描述编辑意图，例如增删元素、风格转换、局部修改
zh.field.model.label: 模型
zh.field.responseModalities.label: 输出类型
zh.field.responseModalities.tooltip: 默认文本+图片；选「仅图片」可抑制文本输出
zh.field.aspectRatio.label: 宽高比
zh.field.imageSize.label: 分辨率
zh.field.imageSize.tooltip: 默认 1K；512 仅 3.1 Flash 支持。注意大写 K（512 无 K）
zh.field.googleSearch.label: Google 搜索 Grounding
zh.field.googleSearch.tooltip: 基于 Google 实时搜索结果生成图片（天气、新闻、股价等）
zh.field.imageSearch.label: 图片搜索
zh.field.imageSearch.tooltip: 仅 3.1 Flash；以网络图片作为视觉上下文，不能搜索人物
zh.field.thinkingLevel.label: 思考级别
zh.field.thinkingLevel.tooltip: 仅 flash-image 模型；minimal 延迟最低，high 质量更高
zh.field.includeThoughts.label: 返回思考过程
zh.field.includeThoughts.tooltip: 在响应中返回模型的思考过程
zh.field.image.label: 参考图
zh.field.image.tooltip: URL / 本地路径 / data URI，或 JSON 数组；Gemini 3 最多 14 张
zh.field.videoUrl.label: 视频 URL
zh.field.videoUrl.tooltip: 仅 3.1 Flash；YouTube URL 或 Files API URI，用于视频转图片
zh.field.history.label: 对话历史
zh.field.history.tooltip: 多轮编辑的 Gemini contents 数组（JSON），如 [{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"..."}]}]
zh.field.baseUrl.label: API 地址
zh.field.baseUrl.tooltip: Gemini API 基础地址，支持代理
zh.message.imageEdited: 图片编辑完成，生成 {count} 张图片

en.action.createImage.label: Nano Banana Generate Image
en.action.createImage.description: Generate images from text using Google Gemini Nano Banana, with grounding and thinking support.
en.action.editImage.label: Nano Banana Edit Image
en.action.editImage.description: AI image editing and compositing from reference images, multi-turn history, or video. Up to 14 reference images.
en.action.models.label: Nano Banana Model List
en.field.apiKey.label: API Key
en.field.prompt.label: Image Description
en.field.prompt.tooltip: Describe the scene; narrative descriptions beat keyword lists.
en.field.promptEdit.label: Edit Description
en.field.promptEdit.tooltip: Describe the edit intent, e.g. add/remove elements, style transfer, inpainting.
en.field.model.label: Model
en.field.responseModalities.label: Output Type
en.field.responseModalities.tooltip: Text + Image by default; choose Image Only to suppress text.
en.field.aspectRatio.label: Aspect Ratio
en.field.imageSize.label: Resolution
en.field.imageSize.tooltip: Default 1K; 512 only for 3.1 Flash. Use uppercase K (no K for 512).
en.field.googleSearch.label: Google Search Grounding
en.field.googleSearch.tooltip: Ground generation with real-time Google Search results (weather, news, stocks).
en.field.imageSearch.label: Image Search
en.field.imageSearch.tooltip: Only gemini-3.1-flash-image. Use web images as visual context; cannot search for people.
en.field.thinkingLevel.label: Thinking Level
en.field.thinkingLevel.tooltip: Only flash-image models. minimal = lowest latency, high = better quality.
en.field.includeThoughts.label: Include Thoughts
en.field.includeThoughts.tooltip: Return the model thinking process in the response.
en.field.image.label: Reference Images
en.field.image.tooltip: URL / local path / data URI, or JSON array. Up to 14 images (Gemini 3).
en.field.videoUrl.label: Video URL
en.field.videoUrl.tooltip: Only gemini-3.1-flash-image. YouTube URL or Files API URI for video-to-image.
en.field.history.label: Conversation History
en.field.history.tooltip: JSON array of Gemini contents for multi-turn editing, e.g. [{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"..."}]}].
en.field.baseUrl.label: API URL
